hook: 84% survival rate. That drops to 38% when it's caught late.
caption: Oral cancer is one of the few cancers where early detection genuinely changes the outcome. When it's found early, the 5-year survival rate is around 84%. By the time most people notice something's wrong, that number has already fallen. The gap between those two figures isn't luck. It's timing. A free, 2-minute risk screener at oralcheck.org can help you figure out where you stand before anything becomes urgent.
